species: Here, we performed quantitative acetylation proteomics analysis of soft wheat seeds with different germination rates during artificial ageing.
tissue: Here, we performed quantitative acetylation proteomics analysis of soft wheat seeds with different germination rates during artificial ageing.
disease_state: Here, we performed quantitative acetylation proteomics analysis of soft wheat seeds with different germination rates during artificial ageing.
sample_source: Wheat tissue samples with germination rates of 97% and 6% (named YM97 and YM6, respectively) were collected for the quantitative proteomic analysis of acetylation modifications.
strain: The seeds of soft wheat variety ‘Yangmai 15’ selected in this study were purchased from Henan Academy of Agricultural Sciences (Zhengzhou, China), and the artificial ageing method was referred from our previous research.
